title: Impact of Urolithin A (Mitopure) on Mitochondrial Quality in Muscle of Frail Older Adults

sections.abstract: The study is a single-center, randomized, placebo-control double-blind study in frail older adults over 65yrs. to investigate the impact of Mitopure (Urolithin A) supplementation on muscle mitochondrial quality in frail older adults after 8-weeks of supplementation
